subject.title: [Bug]: docker-compose cli service is stranded in a stale network namespace after a gateway restart — healthcheck fails permanently

question: Should the bundled long-running `openclaw-cli` be automatically recreated with a Compose-managed gateway restart, or should it be treated as a post-start command container with its inherited gateway health check disabled and an explicit recreate instruction?
rationale: Both choices change the supported operational contract for a bundled Docker deployment, and the suggested propagation setting may not cover the reporter’s direct `docker restart` reproduction.

options.title: Make Compose own sidecar restarts
options.body: Use and test supported Compose restart propagation plus lifecycle documentation, while retaining a meaningful CLI health policy.

options.title: Disable the sidecar’s inherited probe
options.body: Treat `openclaw-cli` as a command-oriented shared-network sidecar, disable its gateway-specific image health check, and document recreating it after direct gateway restarts.

options.title: Define a dedicated CLI liveness check
options.body: Keep a health status only if it can verify the CLI container itself without assuming its current network namespace remains the gateway’s.

recommendation.title: Disable the sidecar’s inherited probe
recommendation.body: Treat `openclaw-cli` as a command-oriented shared-network sidecar, disable its gateway-specific image health check, and document recreating it after direct gateway restarts.

likelyOwner.reason: Current file history most directly connects this contributor to the Compose deployment surface where the lifecycle contract is defined.
